name: smwsprites-upwards-flying-star-sprite-v1
title: Upwards Flying Star Sprite v1.1
description:
This is my first serious custom sprite. It's a star sprite which flies up and stops at a certain position which you can easily set in the ASM file.
You could for example let it spawn out from a block, like with these.
The graphics work with the default palette A but be sure to give credit to BlackSquirrel for those.
I tried to document the ASM file as good as I could so there shouldn't be too much troubles by customizing it a bit.
No credit needed, just have fun with it. GFX goes in SP4

v1.1 Update:
- Added customisability options
- Fixed AMK compatibility
- Made the position to be set using the first two extra bytes
- Star gives points upon collection
- Removed extra graphics
- Replaced SA-1 defines to new one
